marketing_description: The Milwaukee 3052-20 Ratchet features a 1/4 in square drive, 45 ft-lb torque rating, and variable speed control up to 550 RPM. Powered by a 12 V M12 battery with 2 Ah capacity, this tool is designed with an ergonomic rubber handle and metal housing for durability. The POWERSTATE Brushless Motor provides efficient performance.
